top_comments.body:
This issue is still happening I'm noticing it happens every day maybe 24 hours? The way I fix it is:

Uninstall Claude Code
Install 1.00.67
LogIn
/Exit
Open Claude Code
This resolves the problem temporarily for at least 24 hours.
